title: Dual-targeting sulfamethoxazole derivatives overcome multidrug resistance in ESKAPE pathogens by inhibiting quorum sensing and efflux pumps
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,8921-8944
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA08024J, Paper
Open Access

Benedicta Yayra Adzah, Prince Danan Biniyam, Victoria Ohene-Adu, Michael Osei, Kwabena Adu-Adjei, Victoria Elmes, Iain Goodall, Vuvor Faustina, Yvonne Dogbeda Agboyibor, Patrick Gyan, Paul Quansah, Cyril Makafui Amengor, Joshua Boateng, En Zhang, Maxwell Ampomah-Wireko, Ernest Oyeh, Cedric Dzidzor Kodjo Amengor
An integrated computational and experimental approach validated five (5) sulphamethoxazole derivatives targeting dihydropteroate synthase (DHPS) protein as dual inhibitors of quorum sensing (LasR) and efflux pumps (AcrB) with SMX033 as the best hit.
